text:
Aisha Khan: FYI I'm drafting a short customer note and a CS playbook for the tenants affected by the ingest hiccup on 2026-03-22. Want to send targeted to high-touch first and include a renewal-risk outreach plan. Draft below — quick edits please.

Diego Morales: Lead with an apology, include exact UTC window, and call out which onboarding flows were impacted (CSV bulk ingest + remote connector). Also: propose a proactive CSAT check and a small service credit for any confirmed data loss.

Lena Chen: SRE one-line for customers: "Root cause: a malformed protobuf bypassed upstream validation, causing worker retry storms and queue backlog; we deployed a schema-validation gate and controlled replays to recover." Window: 2026-03-22 03:10:12Z  03:48:09Z.

Aisha Khan: Adding that. Also adding a short internal checklist for CS reps so messaging is consistent: 1) confirm whether the tenant saw missing records, 2) offer prioritized backfill, 3) offer enablement session, 4) log credit.

Priya Nair: I uploaded the renewal-risk list and a suggested script for 1:1 calls: https://redwood-internal/drive/renewal-risk-3-22.csv. Recommend Sales join the top 8 calls.

Aisha Khan: Draft customer email (short):

"Hi {{first_name}},
Were sorry  On March 22 between 03:10 and 03:48 UTC some onboarding imports (CSV bulk ingest and a minority of connector runs) were delayed for a subset of customers. Weve fixed the issue, completed controlled replays for high-priority queues, and added schema validation to prevent recurrence.

What we did:
• Blocked malformed messages with a validation gate.
• Rate-limited replays to avoid downstream spikes.
• Completed prioritized backfills for onboarding flows; reply if you still see missing data and we11 expedite.

What we11 offer:
• A credit for any confirmed ingestion data loss or ingestion overage charges during the outage window.
• A complimentary enablement session for affected onboarding customers; reply to book.

If you11 like a 1:1 walkthrough, reply and we11 schedule it.
Sincerely,
Aisha Khan, Customer Success"

Diego Morales: For credit wording, use: "We will credit any verified ingestion data loss and waive ingestion overage charges incurred during the outage window. High-touch customers will also receive one month of complimentary platform credit."

Lena Chen: LGTM. Add a short technical FAQ link and the internal RCA link.

Aisha Khan: Will send targeted now, then broadcast. CS reps: follow the checklist and tag messages with #onboard-ingest so we can track responses. Priya, looping Sales on the renewal-risk list.

CS Bot: IncidentBot: INGEST-874 detected 2026-03-22T03:10:12Z, resolved 2026-03-22T03:48:09Z. Postmortem: https://redwood-internal/pg/INGEST-874/postmortem

Priya Nair: Adding note: run the renewal-health tracker after outreach and surface any at-risk customers for an executive touch.

Aisha Khan: Thanks team  sending targeted messages and scheduling two office hours (EMEA/AMER + APAC). Will file copies to the incident page and follow up with a CSAT pulse next week. :sparkles:
